title: DaemonCommand
description:
Client commands, tagged by `type`. Every variant carries `id` (bare
commands) and a catch-all for unknown fields, so round-trips stay lossless.

oneOf.description: `list_saved_sessions` (session- and cwd-addressed forms share this shape).

workerToken.description:
The requester's worker token; optional on the wire (an absent
token is an auth failure, not a parse one).

oneOf.description:
Worker-to-worker peer ticket: mint a single-use `worker`-purpose grant for a target worker's
direct socket, bypassing the supervisor's route plane; authenticated by the requester's
worker token, like `list_agent_peers`.

Worker -> supervisor idle-passivation request: a parent-owned child whose idle clock crossed
`idleEvictionMinutes` asks for the graceful stop; the supervisor verifies the worker token
and the parent-owned descriptor. Clients never send this.

Worker -> supervisor roster delta (TS `roster_delta`): the worker pushes its slim session
summary so the roster tracks live status without polling.

sequence.description:
Monotonic per-worker sequence; the supervisor drops a delta older
than one already applied. Absent means unsequenced (always applied).

workerInstanceId.description:
The sending worker process instance: a replacement reuses the
worker id but restarts its sequence, so the stale-delta gate keeps
one generation slot per worker and drops a predecessor's deltas.

telemetryDisabled.description: Telemetry opt-out: only ever `Some(true)`; absent means enabled.

env.description: Allowlisted client env vars (`env`), carried on create only.

renamedBy.description:
Who directed the rename (`renamedBy` on the wire, TS
`AgentFamilyRelationship` — only `"parent"` is sent): set when a
parent session renames one of its direct children, so the
renamed session's transcript notice can name it.

oneOf.description: `prompt`/`steer`/`follow_up`-family input payload.

admissionId.description: Unique only when the caller needs cancellable pre-ownership admission.

rlmNoticeNonce.description:

a caller-supplied value can never name a live mint.

oneOf.description:
`abort_and_send_queued` (schema 29, capability-gated in TS): abort the run and deliver the
queued steering batch at the turn boundary (TS `AgentSession.abortAndSendQueued`).
Rust-native extension, advertised by the `kernel_bash_activity` capability.

The `/factory` view's bridge lane over the session kernel's factory
executor (`graph`/`status`/`watch`/`run`/`stop`/`resume`).
Rust-native extension, advertised by the `factory_activity` capability.

waitForRlmQuiescence.description:
Also hold until every RLM child run of the session settled
(the `wait_for_headless_completion` barrier of the same name).

oneOf.description:
The inline paste flow: install a pasted static token for one
pasteable catalog service, verifying with a real MCP handshake.

Remove one MCP connection: credential and connection record (the
durable endpoint pin) in one step.
Rename one MCP account's identity label (the inline rename surface).
Stateless, bounded workstream classification through the authenticated model registry.
`inputId`, `action` and `text` ride `rest`.

Rust-native client command (operator directive 2026-09-29): the
interactive client's report that it just drew the Anthropic
subscription ban-risk warning — the worker persists the session's
once-per-lifecycle marker row so a reattach, a resume, or a worker
replacement of the same session skips the warning (the TS gate is
per interactive-mode instance, so the TS protocol has no
counterpart; an older daemon rejects the frame and the client
degrades to its per-instance gate).

Rust-native client command (the desktop's inline prompt guidelines):
stage appended sources for the next successful compaction; a rebind
of an existing worker skips the source refresh, so the client pushes
its current list.

Coordinator -> supervisor: start (or idempotently poll) the prepare transaction for
`updateId`; same id returns the current state, a different id is refused.

Coordinator -> supervisor: consume the prepared transaction and stop
gracefully (the only consumption of the prepared artifact).

Query the supervisor's boot-time restore pass (spec §6/§9): whether the restore is in flight
and the per-session counts/failures for the coordinator's `Restoring` phase. Read-only.

Session-worker self-registration (worker -> supervisor); the same
command re-registers after a supervisor restart. The token was issued
by the supervisor, so only the real worker can present it.

GlobalHarnessDefaultsPatch.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged. Explicit null is not a reset operation.

DaemonResumeCursor.description:
Resume cursor accepted on attach. The TS wire shape is a union (`DaemonEventCursor`, or a bare
`eventSequence`, each with optional `activeSessionId`); this optional-field struct accepts both
forms and serializes each back to its original shape.

AgentMessage.description:
Conversation message stored in `message` entries: the provider-facing
messages from [`crate::ai`] plus the coding-agent-only roles.

UserContent.description: User/tool-result content: a plain string or a list of text/image blocks.

UserContentBlock.description: Content blocks in user/tool-result messages: a `text` block, an `image` block, or any other JSON shape (unknown kinds preserved verbatim).

textSignature.description:
`OpenAI` Responses metadata: a legacy id string or a [`TextSignatureV1`] JSON payload (TS
wire key `textSignature`; the camelCase rename keeps it attached across the pa-ai <->
pa-agent round trips, which have no catch-all).

ImageContent.description: Image content block (`type: "image"`); data is base64.

AssistantContentBlock.description: Content blocks allowed in assistant messages.

thinkingSignature.description:
Provider reasoning item id, or the encoded reasoning-details payload for redacted blocks (TS
wire key `thinkingSignature`; the camelCase rename keeps it attached across the pa-ai <->
pa-agent round trips, where a `snake_case` key was silently dropped).

redacted.description: True when the thinking content was redacted by safety filters.

thoughtSignature.description:
Google-specific opaque signature for reusing thought context (TS
wire key `thoughtSignature`; see [`ThinkingContent`] for the rename).

AssistantMessageDiagnostic.description: One redacted provider/runtime diagnostic attached to an assistant message.

DiagnosticErrorInfo.description: Error info captured inside a diagnostic.

JsNumber.description:
An f64 that (de)serializes with JavaScript `JSON.stringify` number parity. TypeScript numbers
are
f64 and `JSON.stringify` prints integral values without a fractional part (`0`, not `0.0`);
Rust's `f64` serialization always prints `0.0`, which would break lossless round-trips against
TS-produced files. This newtype prints integral values as integers, everything else via the
shortest f64 representation.

oneOf.description:
Terminal reason of a turn that ended in tool calls; also accepts the
raw `OpenAI` wire value `tool_calls` (TS keeps any `stopReason`
string, so foreign session files never lose assistant rows).

responseModel.description: Concrete `chunk.model` when different from the requested model.

responseId.description: Provider-specific response identifier, when exposed upstream.

diagnostics.description: Redacted provider/runtime diagnostics for failures and recoveries.

stopReasonRaw.description: Provider's raw stop/finish reason when it mapped to `"error"`.

details.description: Structured details for logs or UI rendering.

BashExecutionMessage.description: `role: "bashExecution"`: a `!`-command execution, rendered as a user turn.

exitCode.description: Exit status; absent while the command is still running.

excludeFromContext.description: True excludes this message from LLM context (`!!` prefix).

BranchSummaryMessage.description: `role: "branchSummary"`: summary of a branch the conversation returned from.

CompactionSummaryMessage.description: `role: "compactionSummary"`: compaction result presented as a user turn.

retainedMessageCount.description: Retained messages that precede this summary in transcript presentation.

customInstructions.description: User instructions that guided the summary (`/compact <instructions>`).

harnessDigest.description: Harness digest snapshot attached mechanically at compaction.

harnessStateFingerprint.description:
Fingerprint of the harness state behind `harness_digest`; lets cold
boundaries skip re-delivery (TS #2400).

ServiceTier.description:
TS `ServiceTier = "auto" | "default" | "flex" | "scale" | "priority" | null`.
The wire value can be absent or an explicit null, both mapping to `None`.
